full_prompt_en: A square hyperreal painted image shows a young face extremely close behind wet glass, with droplets and flowing water marks crossing the features. The background is dark and indistinct, shifting from deep blue-black at the left edge to warmer shadow around the right side of the face. One green-brown eye looks outward from the upper left-center under a dark brow, sharply focused despite the uneven transparent layer in front of it. The nose runs down the right half of the frame and is partly cut by the edge; a softly closed red-pink mouth lies near the lower center. Warm skin is modeled with amber, rose, and cream patches, interrupted by cool reflections and irregular droplets. Small beads of water cling to the glass around the eye and cheek, catching white highlights. Larger vertical streaks pass over the forehead, down the nose bridge, and across the mouth, distorting nearby color and contour. A dark strand of hair curves along the far left edge and disappears into the background. The face fills almost all available space, so the droplets read simultaneously as a surface in front of the subject and as an abstract pattern across the image. Soft illumination arrives from the front and upper right, brightening the nose and cheek while leaving the left boundary and lower corner in shadow. The water reflects narrower, brighter light than the matte skin, creating a contrast between slick glass and delicately textured flesh. The underlying painted detail remains precise around the eye, lashes, lip edge, and skin transitions, while refraction makes other portions soft and broken. No setting or readable words are visible. The overall composition is intimate and tense, using layered transparency, cool-dark framing, and warm human color to make the viewer aware of the barrier between them and the face.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超写实绘画图像呈现一张年轻面孔，紧贴在湿玻璃后方，水滴与流水痕跨过五官。背景深暗且不清晰，从左缘的深蓝黑转向脸右侧的暖阴影。一只绿棕色眼睛在上部偏左处从深眉下望向外面，尽管前方透明层不平整，眼睛仍很清楚。鼻子沿画面右半部向下，部分被边缘裁掉；下部中央附近是一张柔和闭合的红粉色嘴。暖色皮肤由琥珀、玫瑰与奶油白色块塑形，被冷色反射和不规则水珠打断。小水珠附着在眼和面颊前方玻璃上，接住白色高光。更大的竖向水痕从额头经过鼻梁与嘴边，使附近色彩与轮廓扭曲。一缕深发沿最左边缘弯曲，消失在背景中。面孔占据几乎所有空间，因此水珠既读作主体前的表面，也成为遍布图像的抽象图案。柔光从前方略偏右上照来，提亮鼻梁和脸颊，让左边界及下角保持阴影。水反射的光比哑光皮肤更窄、更亮，形成湿滑玻璃与细致皮肤肌理之间的对比。底层绘画细节在眼、睫毛、唇缘和皮肤过渡处仍然精确，其他部分则因折射变软、破碎。画中没有环境或可读文字。整体构图亲密而紧张，以层叠透明、冷暗围框和温暖人体彩色让观者感到自己与面孔之间的隔层。
style_prompt_en: The hyperreal painting layers precise underlying form beneath a visibly wet, translucent surface. Warm amber, rose, and cream color is fractured by cool blue-gray reflections, making one plane appear close and slick while another recedes behind it. Tiny bright beads and longer vertical smears interrupt contours without fully hiding them. The sharpest detail is concentrated in a small focal area; surrounding edges dissolve into dark, soft passages and optical distortion. Highlights on moisture are narrow and almost white, unlike the broader matte glow on the underlying material. Extreme cropping removes environmental context and turns texture into a dominant compositional element. The overall effect is intimate and psychologically charged, using refraction, selective sharpness, and contrasting surface responses to light as its visual engine.
style_prompt_zh: 这种超写实绘画把精确的底层形体置于明显潮湿的半透明表面之后。暖琥珀、玫瑰色与奶油白被冷蓝灰反光打碎，让一层显得靠近且湿滑，另一层退到后方。细小亮水珠与更长竖痕打断轮廓，却不完全遮盖它。最锐利细节集中于一小处焦点，周围边缘溶入深暗柔软区域和光学扭曲。湿气上的高光狭窄且几乎纯白，不同于底层材料更宽的哑光辉光。极近裁切移去环境语境，使肌理成为主要构图元素。整体效果亲密且带心理张力，以折射、选择性清晰度和不同表面受光反应作为视觉动力。
theme_en: A close face seen through wet glass with water drops and streaks
theme_zh: 一张隔着湿玻璃所见的近景面孔，前方布满水滴与水痕
name: Alyssa Monks
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
